body:
### Summary

Due to recent infosec hilarity I would like to avoid having old certificate bundles on my system, and as such I would like to upgrade all the available Python versions to their latest bugfix releases and then remove the old ones.

I had a number of Python versions installed by uv.  Focusing to just 3.14, I had

- cpython-3.14.7-linux-x86_64-gnu
- cpython-3.14.7+freethreaded-linux-x86_64-gnu

Then I ran `uv python upgrade` and got

- cpython-3.14.9-linux-x86_64-gnu

I expected to also get cpython-3.14.9+freethreaded-linux-x86_64-gnu, which is a thing that exists according to `uv python list --only-downloads`.

(Now I'm off to write a script to clean up the old versions, since #15805 seems stuck.)

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04 on WSL (Linux 6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2 x86_64 GNU/Linux)

### Version

uv 0.13.5 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

Python 3.12.3
title: `uv python upgrade` doesn't upgrade free-threaded versions
